executive_summary: Your amber rating is driven entirely by geopolitical concentration risk, not financial distress or macro headwinds. Four distinct geographic clusters are creating compounding exposure: US-China trade tensions and Taiwan risk affect five suppliers across EMS, batteries, nicotine, and substrates (Huizhou BYD, Smoore, EVE Energy, IP Sun, Porton); Russia-NATO proximity threatens your Finnish substrate supplier (Stora Enso); North Korea regional tensions expose your South Korean filter supplier (Tae Young); and India-China border friction threatens your high-exposure nicotine source (ITC). The two unexplained equity drops (Sappi and SWM) warrant quick investor calls to rule out hidden operational issues, but both are secondary to the geopolitical picture. Immediate action: map dual-source options for EMS and batteries given their critical exposure and China concentration, and develop Taiwan disruption contingencies that account for cascading substrate shortages if conflict escalates. The macro pillar is green, so this is a pure supply-side orchestration problem, not a demand or financing crisis.
